purpose: Four art direction mockups for review, before implementation.

variants.title: 1 — Camp de nuit
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: an art direction proposal for the existing Rabbit Royale game shop, a polished finished landscape 16:9 game screenshot, at least 1536 pixels wide. One image only, one complete screen, no device, no presentation board, no split views, no watermarks.
Primary request: show a major quality upgrade to a simple parchment shop, on par with premium richly illustrated pixel-art game settings and daily snack reward screens. The game features small charming square-bodied rabbits, carrot currency, tropical islands, forest burrows, buried bombs, lightning, shields, fence defenses and squid-shaped purple bloops. Stay in this game's recognizable handmade pixel-art universe.
Shared functional layout: a legible top bar with "SHOP" at left, a carrot balance "1 240" at right and a close X. Clearly distinct navigation tabs "PACKS", "ITEMS", "SKINS", each with a relevant small icon. PACKS is selected. Separate smaller payment selector "CARROTS", "USDC", "SOL", "SKR", with carrots selected, visually subordinate to category navigation. Main shop contains exactly FOUR bundle product displays in one coherent spacious row: 
1 "SHIRO'S STASH": friendly little white rabbit, 2 black round bombs, 2 wooden fences, 1 blue shield, price "1 200" plus carrot icon.
2 "KURO'S TANTRUM": mischievous small dark charcoal rabbit with purple accents, 2 yellow lightning bolts, 3 purple squid bloops, price "1 040" plus carrot icon.
3 "3 REFILLS": one ornate green and gold circular energy medallion, visible "x3", price "1 680" plus carrot icon.
4 "10 REFILLS": matching green and gold medallions, visible "x10", price "5 600" plus carrot icon.
A small tasteful "-20%" stamp on bundles. Main prices are large readable action buttons. Product artwork must be large, composed, charming, collectible, not tiny overlapping icons. Short meaningful product subtitles are optional; do not fill screen with text.
Below the packs a visually SEPARATE low horizontal skins showcase labelled "SKINS" with two excellent rabbit character previews labelled "SOLANA" (purple green gradient pixel rabbit) and "CARROT" (bright warm orange pixel rabbit), and a compact "VIEW SKINS" action; do not mingle skins into the packs row. This lower showcase is a distinct collection preview, not an item pack.
Typography: crisp game bitmap lettering, extremely legible hierarchy, centered product names, correct requested text. Interface has convincing button hit areas, consistent alignment and padding, implementable as separated game UI layers. Decoration frames content, does not obscure it.
Style: highly art-directed handcrafted pixel-art, visible clean pixel clusters and careful light/shadow, coherent pixel scale, rich environmental storytelling, beautiful painted pixel textures. NOT modern web UI, not flat SaaS cards, not glossy mobile casino, no realistic 3D, no blurry brushwork. The art should occupy the screen with intention; no giant empty plain background.
Art direction 1 — NIGHT RAID CAMP. Palette: deep midnight navy #071f2c, dark petrol teal #113e49, warm copper #ed863b, luminous cream #f5e4bf, restrained moss green. A moonlit tropical island camp frames the shop, moon and palm silhouettes above, torchlit stones at the edges. The UI is made of finely detailed dark blue teal inset panels, elegant copper corner rails and restrained vines, with sculpted burnt-orange selected navigation. Large pack cards look like recessed quartermaster display cases with beautiful turquoise rims, and matching warm copper price plaques. A small lantern and provisions crate integrated beside the shop heading. The white Shiro and purple Kuro bundles feel like two small tableaux on a stone ledge, with items precisely arranged and quantity labels separately readable. Refill displays sit on carved pedestals. Blue night is dominant, warm amber lighting leads the eye to products and price. Premium beautiful atmospheric art, restrained disciplined ornamentation. This should feel like the exact SHOP counterpart to an illustrated night-camp settings screen.

Art direction 2 — THE WOODLAND MARKET STALL. Palette: deep walnut #43291e, honey oak #a66735, warm golden sunlight #edbd62, leafy moss #759239 and aged linen cream #f3dfb0. A cozy open-air rabbit merchant stall in a lush forest clearing at late afternoon, with a restrained striped warm linen canopy, hanging amber lantern, leafy corners and elaborately illustrated timber joinery. The entire shop is a tangible wooden cabinet: functional navigation as carved wooden drawer tabs with brass pins, a raised emerald inlay for the selected PACKS tab, and the products sit in four distinct open cubbies on a continuous chunky worn wooden shelf. Product cubbies have deep rich shadow interiors, beautifully lit objects in front, gorgeous rabbit illustration for white Shiro and dark Kuro. Carrot prices live on attached brass-trimmed wooden price plaques below each cubby. A separate shallow lower display drawer showcases the two skins on mannequin-like small platforms, clearly labelled SKINS. No generic floating cards on a beige background. Make it feel tactile, lush, golden and handbuilt, the shop equivalent of a premium illustrated Snack Time cabinet. Clear gameplay utility, beautiful disciplined pixel-art details.

Art direction 3 — THE UNDERGROUND BURROW OUTFITTER. Palette: cool slate #263b40, mossy dark green #284c38, terracotta earth #774531, carrot-orange #f18d39, warm bone #f2e2ba. Side-on view into an enchanting rabbit burrow supply workshop, roots across the earthen ceiling, heavy oak beams and stone arch framing, warm workshop lanterns, rolled raid maps, sparse seed sacks and baskets only at the edges. Interface design is a carefully organized quartermaster workbench, not a fantasy magic shop. Left two pack displays are wooden supply crates with hinged lids and subtle blue/purple cloth linings, white rabbit Shiro and dark rabbit Kuro presenting the items; the right refill packs are neatly stocked green brass canisters carrying the game's circular energy medallion. Navigation is robust engraved metal label holders attached to wood, orange enamel selected PACKS tab, small strong pictograms. Prices are inset orange enamel action plates. SKINS live in a clearly separate lower wardrobe rail with two neatly framed rabbit portrait previews. Strong material contrast: natural raw earth, tailored dark canvas, worn metal fittings, warm light, highly readable cream text. Less decorative foliage, more believable handmade workshop construction. Chunky charming pixel art, mature and cohesive, cozy adventurous practical.

Art direction 4 — THE COLLECTOR'S ARCADE CABINET. Palette: midnight plum #211e3a, desaturated indigo #33365b, old bronze gold #c49a4d, pearlescent cream #fff0d3, small controlled jade #67b39a and violet #9772d6 accents. A jewel-like premium fantasy pixel-art rabbit shop housed in an exquisitely built dark indigo cabinet, taking inspiration from collectible figurine displays and classic console RPG inventory interfaces. Symmetric, architectural, luxuriously organized with fine brass lines and stepped pixel-art corners, tiny stars engraved into wood, deep velvet-backed display niches. Four large beautifully illuminated product plinths with frosted blue-white spotlight pools, Shiro's and Kuro's packs rendered as carefully arranged collectible dioramas with the characters, all objects crisp and readable, no particle clutter. Brass rimmed mechanical navigation tabs, selected PACKS glowing ivory gold, category tabs large and readable. Price actions use warm cream-brass plaques with dark ink. The bottom SKINS strip looks like an exclusive shallow portrait showcase with the two colorful rabbit previews under little glass domes, clearly separated from consumable bundles. The standout is gorgeous character display and rarity presentation, not a night forest scene. No neon cyberpunk, no futuristic holograms, no gambling symbols, no purple fog, no excessive sparkles. High-end retro game shop, coherent exquisite pixel art.
